# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of Alarmio Health receives fixes. Please update through HACS before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.**

Email **support@alarmio.net** with the subject "Alarmio Health security", and include:

- what you found and where (file, setting or panel screen);
- the Alarmio Health version and your Home Assistant version;
- steps to reproduce, if you have them.

Do not include your Alarmio session token, passwords or your device names in the report. If a token may have been exposed, sign out of Alarmio and sign in again to replace it.

We will acknowledge your report and keep you informed while we work on a fix.

## What this integration does with your data

Alarmio Health never arms or disarms your alarm and never sends your password or session token as data. It sends a small heartbeat to Alarmio; sharing more is opt-in and off by default. See the Privacy section of the README for the full list.
